laws.name: Alabama Military Family Leave Act
laws.description: Provides unpaid leave for eligible employees with family members in the U.S. Armed Forces who are on active duty or have been notified of an impending call to active duty.

laws.name: Alabama State Employee Sick Leave
laws.description: Provides paid sick leave for eligible Alabama state employees for personal illness or injury.

laws.name: Alabama State Employee Family Sick Leave
laws.description: Allows Alabama state employees to use accrued sick leave to care for an immediate family member with an illness or injury.
